scope: Disposable real HTTP audit chronology checks with synthetic same-second events, migration backfill, transaction rollback and offline VACUUM/restart. Historical backfill uses the surviving insertion-order approximation; it cannot recover previously lost chronology.

checks.name: migration backfills every audit without rewriting records and preserves surviving tied insertion order
Overview and Audit Log use timestamp then permanent sequence, preserve names and reject anonymous reads
rolled-back audit inserts leave neither record nor sequence mapping
offline VACUUM and server restart retain exact audit bytes, sequence values and both HTTP orderings
